title: Borland pulls AARO reports on baiting craft and taking them down

tellings.quote: And then I can begin to pull reports and briefings from Arrow and reports about baiting craft uh and how to take them down,

plain: Around 2023 there were government reports and briefings on how to lure unknown craft and bring them down, and Dylan Borland, a former Air Force intelligence specialist, says he pulled them himself. He says his access through the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, a Pentagon agency for weapons of mass destruction, let him "pull reports and briefings from Arrow," meaning AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate unidentified aerial phenomena, including "reports about baiting craft uh and how to take them down." If true, the government is not just watching these craft but working out how to capture them.
